purpose: Run pinned detector-simulation capabilities of Allpix Squared (silicon pixel charge collection) and Garfield++ (gas-table queries) as content-addressed plans through one CLI, detsim.py (docs/dev/detector-simulation/TASK.md). 0.1.0 is the shared layer's plan and identity part (work item W3a): the contracts detector-task/1, detector-plan/1, detsim-completeness/1 and detsim-observables/1 (contracts 3.18.0); canonical/1 (the repository's canonical_sha256 behind a hash-scope check that refuses binary floats, integers beyond 2^53 - 1, non-ASCII keys, duplicate keys, NaN, lone surrogates and unresolved path or $NAME references) and decimal/1 (exact normalized decimal strings for physical quantities); plan assembly from a task, its inputs (hashed, resolved inside the project), a validated environment record, the trusted backend's ExecutionSpec and a runner profile (macos-g0 as measured, linux-g0 all unsupported until measured); the rebuild comparison that refuses a stale plan with plan-stale and the mismatched fields; plan_digest, run digest and run_id; the verbs describe, check (without --probe) and prepare (with --digest-only) that launch nothing. run, inspect and check --probe (lock, runner, commit) and both backends are later work items: they answer not-run. Every record is unvalidated: no state implies physical validity. Optional, required by no skill

tools.name: Shared layer: detsim.py and its sibling modules detsim_canonical.py, detsim_profile.py, detsim_schemas.py, detsim_plan.py (this plugin's code, standard library, core and contracts only); tested with the simulator-free backend tests/adapters/detsim_backend_synthetic.py

Allpix Squared backend (detsim_backend_allpix.py, capability allpix.pixel-charge; https://gitlab.cern.ch/allpix-squared/allpix-squared; licence recorded when the backend is pinned): not part of this version
Garfield++ backend (detsim_backend_garfield.py, capability garfield.gas-table-query; https://gitlab.cern.ch/garfield/garfieldpp; licence recorded when the backend is pinned): not part of this version

licence_boundary: Nothing of Allpix Squared or Garfield++ is bundled, copied or linked by this version; the adapter's own code is Apache-2.0 like the plugin. Backends will run as separate programs in an environment the user approves; gas tables, field maps, builds and images are never committed
environment: none declared: 0.1.0 runs no backend (its unit tests use only the standard library, core, contracts and a simulator-free test backend)
status_rule: the adapter status is the lowest of its tools' statuses; the shared layer becomes demonstrated-on-synthetic-data only when run, lock and commit are tested with cooperative programs (W3b), and a backend only when its task card's checks pass in a recorded environment; a completed run is verification, never physical validity
